context: This criteria evaluates correct usage of the library's chaining API to apply sequential operations. It checks that chain() is used to start the chain, that operations are applied as method calls on the chain object, and that done() is called to extract the final value.

checklist.name: Uses chain() to start
checklist.description: The implementation calls chain(start) to initiate a chain wrapping the starting value, rather than applying operations imperatively.

checklist.name: Calls done() at end
checklist.description: The chain is finalized by calling .done() to extract the numeric result from the chain wrapper.

checklist.name: Operations applied as chain methods
checklist.description: Each operation (add, subtract, multiply, divide, pow, sqrt, abs) is applied as a method call on the chain object, chaining them sequentially.

checklist.name: Correct results for all operations
checklist.description: All supported operation types (add, subtract, multiply, divide, pow, sqrt, abs) produce correct results when applied via the chain.

checklist.name: Handles empty operations array
checklist.description: When the operations array is empty, the function returns the start value unchanged.
